links.outcome: MAE, quality and accuracy of LLM caries risk classification under guideline-informed versus unguided prompting
links.effect: Guideline-informed and guideline-only prompting significantly reduced MAE and improved quality and accuracy versus unguided (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Guideline-informed and guideline-only prompting significantly reduced MAE and improved quality and accuracy compared with the unguided condition (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: LLM caries risk output agreement with expert-panel reference classifications
links.effect: MAE differed significantly across model-prompting combinations for both tools (p < 0.001); ChatGPT had lower MAE than Gemini for Cariogram (p = 0.002); inter- and intra-rater ICC 0.89-0.93.
links.quote: MAE differed significantly across AI model-prompting condition combinations for both tools (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Effect of structured guideline-based prompts versus unguided prompts on LLM output accuracy
links.effect: Guideline-informed and guideline-only prompting significantly reduced MAE and improved quality and accuracy compared with unguided prompting (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: LLM performance on numerical/algorithmic components of the Cariogram
links.effect: Numerical or algorithmic components, such as those in the Cariogram, remain challenging; ChatGPT had lower MAE than Gemini on the Cariogram (p = 0.002).
links.quote: However, performance depends on the CRA tool and AI model, and numerical or algorithmic components, such as those in the Cariogram, remain challenging.
